comment: Each entry names one file, the index of the screen it is excepted from, and
the reason. The screen order is the order of the encoded forbidden table;
tests/unit/test_public_surface.py asserts that every entry here has a
non-empty reason, names a file that exists, and is load-bearing: removing it
produces a finding. An exception for text that is no longer present therefore
fails the suite rather than quietly widening the allowed surface.
